result.question: What is the trend in Apple's research and development spending over the last three fiscal years?
result.answer: Apple's research and development (R&D) spending has increased each fiscal year over the last three reported years, reflecting a consistent upward trend. In FY 2023 (fiscal year ending September 30, 2023), R&D expense was $29,915 million [c1]. In FY 2024 (fiscal year ending September 28, 2024), R&D expense rose to $31,370 million [c2], an increase of approximately $1,455 million, or about 4.9% year over year [c1][c2]. In FY 2025 (fiscal year ending September 27, 2025), R&D expense further increased to $34,550 million [c3], representing an increase of approximately $3,180 million, or about 10.1% over FY 2024 [c2][c3]. Overall, Apple's R&D spending grew from $29,915 million in FY 2023 to $34,550 million in FY 2025, a cumulative increase of roughly $4,635 million over the three-year period [c1][c3].
